title: EcoManager
description: A high-performance, lightweight, and dupe-safe economy manager for modern Minecraft servers. Supports PlaceholderAPI and custom formatting.
body:
**![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f85a4ddae16c9e21b9ca8db4c14d7cc372d900f_0.webp)

EcoManager is a robust and efficient economy solution designed for modern Minecraft servers (1.21+). It provides a seamless experience for both administrators and players with its lightweight structure and built-in security features.

# **✨ Features**

## **🚀 High Performance:**

Optimized data handling to ensure zero lag on your server.🛡️ Dupe-Safe: Strict checks on transactions to prevent money exploits and "scientific notation" errors.

## **📊 PlaceholderAPI Support:**

Show player balances anywhere (Scoreboards, Tab-lists) with ease.

## **📉 Smart Formatting:**

Automatically converts large numbers into readable formats (e.g., 1M,
1.5B, 2T).

## **⚙️ Fully Configurable:**

Customize every message, currency symbols, and balance limits. Full compatibility with LuckPerms for granular command control.

## **🛠️ Commands & Permissions**

/balance [player]Check your or others' balanceecomanager.player

/baltopView the top 10 richest playersecomanager.player

/pay <player> <amount>Transfer money to another playerecomanager.player

/ecohelpView help menu and placeholdersecomanager.player

/eco <add|take|set>Administrative balance managementecomanager.admin

/eco reloadReload the configuration and dataecomanager.admin

## **🧩 Placeholders**

This plugin requires PlaceholderAPI for these to work:

%ecomanager_money% - Displays the full raw balance (e.g., 1250.50).

%ecomanager_formatted% - Displays the shortened balance (e.g., 1.25K).**
